paragraphs.text: translated by
1. ENJOY, O Agni, this my Fuel, welcome the oil-filled ladle where we pour libation.
paragraphs.original: इमां मे अग्ने समिधं जुषस्वेळस्पदे प्रति हर्या घृताचीम् ।
paragraphs.translit: imāṃ me agne samidhaṃ juṣasveḷaspade prati haryā ghṛtācīm |

paragraphs.text: Rise up for worship of the Gods, wise Agni, on the earth's height, while days are bright with beauty.
paragraphs.original: वर्ष्मन्पृथिव्याः सुदिनत्वे अह्नामूर्ध्वो भव सुक्रतो देवयज्या
paragraphs.translit: varṣmanpṛthivyāḥ sudinatve ahnāmūrdhvo bhava sukrato devayajyā

paragraphs.text: 2. May he who goes before the Gods come hither with steeds whose shapes are varied, Narasarhsa.
paragraphs.original: आ देवानामग्रयावेह यातु नराशंसो विश्वरूपेभिरश्वैः ।
paragraphs.translit: ā devānāmagrayāveha yātu narāśaṃso viśvarūpebhiraśvaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: May he, most Godlike, speed our offered viands with homage God-ward on the path of Order.
paragraphs.original: ऋतस्य पथा नमसा मियेधो देवेभ्यो देवतमः सुषूदत्
paragraphs.translit: ṛtasya pathā namasā miyedho devebhyo devatamaḥ suṣūdat

paragraphs.text: 3. Men with oblations laud most constant Agni, and pray him to perform an envoy's duty.
paragraphs.original: शश्वत्तममीळते दूत्याय हविष्मन्तो मनुष्यासो अग्निम् ।
paragraphs.translit: śaśvattamamīḷate dūtyāya haviṣmanto manuṣyāso agnim |

paragraphs.text: With lightly-rolling car and best draught-horses, bring the Gods hither and sit down as Hotar.
paragraphs.original: वहिष्ठैरश्वैः सुवृता रथेना देवान्वक्षि नि षदेह होता
paragraphs.translit: vahiṣṭhairaśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathenā devānvakṣi ni ṣadeha hotā

paragraphs.text: 4. May the delight of Gods spread out transversely: may it be with us long in length and fragrant.
paragraphs.original: वि प्रथतां देवजुष्टं तिरश्चा दीर्घं द्राघ्मा सुरभि भूत्वस्मे ।
paragraphs.translit: vi prathatāṃ devajuṣṭaṃ tiraścā dīrghaṃ drāghmā surabhi bhūtvasme |

paragraphs.text: O Holy Grass divine, with friendly spirit bring thou the willing Gods whose Chief is Indra.
paragraphs.original: अहेळता मनसा देव बर्हिरिन्द्रज्येष्ठाँ उशतो यक्षि देवान्
paragraphs.translit: aheḷatā manasā deva barhirindrajyeṣṭhām̐ uśato yakṣi devān

paragraphs.text: 5. Touch ye the far-extending height of heaven or spring apart to suit the wide earth's measure.
paragraphs.original: दिवो वा सानु स्पृशता वरीयः पृथिव्या वा मात्रया वि श्रयध्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: divo vā sānu spṛśatā varīyaḥ pṛthivyā vā mātrayā vi śrayadhvam |

paragraphs.text: Yearning, ye Doors, with those sublime in greatness, seize eagerly the heavenly Car that cometh.
paragraphs.original: उशतीर्द्वारो महिना महद्भिर्देवं रथं रथयुर्धारयध्वम्
paragraphs.translit: uśatīrdvāro mahinā mahadbhirdevaṃ rathaṃ rathayurdhārayadhvam

paragraphs.text: 6. Here in this shrine may Dawn and Night, the Daughters of Heaven, the skillful Goddesses, be seated.
paragraphs.original: देवी दिवो दुहितरा सुशिल्पे उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ ।
paragraphs.translit: devī divo duhitarā suśilpe uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau |

paragraphs.text: In your wide lap, auspicious, willing Ladies may the Gods seat them with a willing spirit.
paragraphs.original: आ वां देवास उशती उशन्त उरौ सीदन्तु सुभगे उपस्थे
paragraphs.translit: ā vāṃ devāsa uśatī uśanta urau sīdantu subhage upasthe

paragraphs.text: 7. Up stands the stone, high burns the fire enkindled: Aditi's lap contains the Friendly Natures
paragraphs.original: ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा बृहदग्निः समिद्धः प्रिया धामान्यदितेरुपस्थे ।
paragraphs.translit: ūrdhvo grāvā bṛhadagniḥ samiddhaḥ priyā dhāmānyaditerupasthe |

paragraphs.text: Ye Two Chief Priests who serve at this our worship, may ye, more skilled, win for us rich possessions.
paragraphs.original: पुरोहितावृत्विजा यज्ञे अस्मिन्विदुष्टरा द्रविणमा यजेथाम्
paragraphs.translit: purohitāvṛtvijā yajñe asminviduṣṭarā draviṇamā yajethām

paragraphs.text: 8. On our wide grass, Three Goddesses be seated: for you have we prepared and made it pleasant.
paragraphs.original: तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरिदं वरीय आ सीदत चकृमा वः स्योनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tisro devīrbarhiridaṃ varīya ā sīdata cakṛmā vaḥ syonam |

paragraphs.text: May Ila, she whose foot drops oil, the Goddess, taste, man-like, sacrifice and well-set presents.
paragraphs.original: मनुष्वद्यज्ञं सुधिता हवींषीळा देवी घृतपदी जुषन्त
paragraphs.translit: manuṣvadyajñaṃ sudhitā havīṃṣīḷā devī ghṛtapadī juṣanta

paragraphs.text: 9. Since thou, God Tvastar, hast made beauty perfect, since thou hast been the Angirases' Companion,
paragraphs.original: देव त्वष्टर्यद्ध चारुत्वमानड्यदङ्गिरसामभवः सचाभूः ।
paragraphs.translit: deva tvaṣṭaryaddha cārutvamānaḍyadaṅgirasāmabhavaḥ sacābhūḥ |

paragraphs.text: Willing, most wealthy, Giver of possessions, grant us the Gods' assembly, thou who knowest.
paragraphs.original: स देवानां पाथ उप प्र विद्वाँ उशन्यक्षि द्रविणोदः सुरत्नः
paragraphs.translit: sa devānāṃ pātha upa pra vidvām̐ uśanyakṣi draviṇodaḥ suratnaḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Well-knowing, binding with thy cord, bring hither, Lord of the Wood, the Deities' assembly.
paragraphs.original: वनस्पते रशनया नियूया देवानां पाथ उप वक्षि विद्वान् ।
paragraphs.translit: vanaspate raśanayā niyūyā devānāṃ pātha upa vakṣi vidvān |

paragraphs.text: The God prepare and season our oblations may Heaven and Earth be gracious to my calling.
paragraphs.original: स्वदाति देवः कृणवद्धवींष्यवतां द्यावापृथिवी हवं मे
paragraphs.translit: svadāti devaḥ kṛṇavaddhavīṃṣyavatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī havaṃ me

paragraphs.text: 11. Agni, bring hither Varuna to help us, Indra from heaven, from air's mid-realm the Maruts.
paragraphs.original: आग्ने वह वरुणमिष्टये न इन्द्रं दिवो मरुतो अन्तरिक्षात् ।
paragraphs.translit: āgne vaha varuṇamiṣṭaye na indraṃ divo maruto antarikṣāt |

paragraphs.text: On sacred grass all Holy ones be seated and let the Immortal Gods rejoice in Svaha.
paragraphs.original: सीदन्तु बर्हिर्विश्व आ यजत्राः स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम्
paragraphs.translit: sīdantu barhirviśva ā yajatrāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām
